claim_reviews.audit: Operating profit reconciles to reported profit, but the locked 4.0% investment return is not distributable cash profit.
NBV and margin improvement are confirmed and channel mix, especially bancassurance, is a material driver.
Closing CSM declined about 0.8%, so high NBV growth has not yet produced verified growth in the in-force profit pool.
P&C COR is currently sound, while Q1 operating profit declined and underwriting-cycle sensitivity remains.
Group EV, life EV, the 4.0% long-run investment return and 7.5%-8.5% risk discount rates are confirmed by S1 evidence.
A 50bp lower long-run investment return reduces group EV by about CNY145.8bn, confirming material assumption sensitivity.
High 2025 total investment return does not remove reinvestment pressure evidenced by low Q1 2026 investment returns.
The 10% equity-price EV sensitivity is confirmed, but permitted evidence cannot fully rebuild allocation changes and hedge-adjusted capital volatility.
Life core and comprehensive solvency ratios and AA ratings are confirmed by the formal solvency report.
P&C solvency ratios are confirmed, but the website AA summary conflicts with A ratings in the linked formal report.
Public evidence does not permit full look-through of real estate, debt plans, wealth products and bank assets, supporting an asset discount.
The CNY2.70 dividend is confirmed, but parent cash also funds subsidiaries and includes convertible financing, weakening free-surplus quality.
The blind 18.108bn current diluted shares and challenger 19.173bn fully diluted shares are not bridged, so exact dilution is unresolved.
The roughly 5% yield is confirmed, but the growth needed for a 12% return depends on payout, dilution and retained-capital returns.
No 2026 interim report was available at cutoff, so undisclosed Q2 data cannot resolve CSM, investment or asset-quality risk.
